---
title: "Brain Data Analysis"
author: "Sachi Vats"
---

Calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain (cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus) regions in human, pig and mouse

# Human

```{r}
elevated_genes_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(elevated_genes_human)
```

# Pig

```{r}
elevated_genes_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(elevated_genes_pig)
```

# Mouse

```{r}
elevated_genes_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(elevated_genes_mouse)
```

Humans had the highest number of genes elevated in the forebrain (430 genes)
